leo1a5dk1.name: Leopard 1A5 DK-1
leo1a5dk1.authority: Main ruled the Denmark line on 2026-10-29 (about 12:50, DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("add a bunch more denmark tanks"): Leopard 1A5 DK-1 at tier I (twin build on the Leopard 1A5 DK), a photo-class first-party build with its Danish kit; no registered 3D comparison exists for this configuration. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
leo1a5dk1.envelopeBasis: Width, length and tallest are the as-built envelope, the 1A5 DK's (published 3.41 m wide, 9.54 m with the gun forward, 2.8 m over the MG). The DK-1 fit (the turret-rear air conditioning and generator housing, the M41 DK-1 searchlight, GPS, United Nations white) follows armyvehicles.dk and Pansermuseet and the DK-1 photographs on Wikimedia Commons.
